title: Apple iPhone Upgrade Program Trends in the US
description: The Apple iPhone Upgrade Program is gaining attention in the US, with reports suggesting Apple may launch a leasing program to spur sales.

Apple to Launch ‘Upgrade’ Device Leasing Program With Klarna to Spur Sales
iOS 27 code suggests Apple could restrict leased devices after missed payments

sections.heading: Apple's Leasing Program
paragraphs: According to Bloomberg.com, Apple is planning to launch an 'Upgrade' device leasing program in partnership with Klarna to encourage sales.

sections.heading: Potential Restrictions on Leased Devices
paragraphs: 9to5Mac reports that code in iOS 27 suggests Apple could restrict the functionality of leased devices if payments are missed.

sections.heading: Context of Apple's Pricing Strategy
paragraphs: CNET discusses the context of Apple's pricing strategy, noting that the company has recently raised Mac prices and is now considering leasing options for customers.

faq.q: What is the Apple iPhone Upgrade Program?
faq.a: The Apple iPhone Upgrade Program allows customers to lease the latest iPhone, with the option to upgrade to a new model every year after a certain period.

faq.q: Why is Apple considering a leasing program?
faq.a: According to Bloomberg.com, Apple aims to spur sales by offering a more flexible and financially accessible option for customers through the 'Upgrade' device leasing program.

faq.q: How might Apple handle missed payments?
faq.a: 9to5Mac suggests that Apple could restrict the functionality of leased devices if customers miss payments, as indicated by code in iOS 27.
